jobs.title: TIER I SERVICE DESK AGENT (JUNIOR, EXTENDED HOURS)
jobs.excerpt: OverviewEmpower AI is AI for government.  Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation.
jobs.description:
Overview

Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai.

Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.

Responsibilities

Description

Empower AI is seeking a motivated Tier I Service Desk Agent (Junior, Extended Hours) to analyze and resolve IT incidents and service requests as a Tier I analyst on an enterprise IT Service Desk supporting a Department of War agency with approximately 13,000 users across multiple security enclaves. Users reach the Service Desk when the AI-driven Tier 0 self-service portal and chatbot have not resolved their issue, so the analyst's core work is judgment: determining what is actually wrong, how much it matters to the mission, what priority it warrants, whether it can be resolved at Tier I or deflected to self-service, and when and where it must be escalated. The analyst also improves the system itself by identifying knowledge and automation gaps and drafting content that shifts work to Tier 0. Performance is measured on First Contact Resolution, SLA adherence, and customer experience scores. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS A REMOTE ROLE WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Analyze incoming incidents and service requests from internal users across phone, chat, email, and portal channels to determine the nature, scope, and business impact of each issue, and independently assign the appropriate Priority Level (PL1 through PL4) and category in the enterprise ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Determine the appropriate resolution approach for each Tier I issue by evaluating symptoms against known errors, knowledge articles, and system behavior, and decide when an issue can be resolved at Tier I, deflected to self-service, or must be escalated to Tier II, Tier III, or a specialized resolver group.
  • Resolve account, access, connectivity, and application issues by selecting and applying the correct diagnostic and remediation steps, including administrative actions on user accounts and configurations within delegated authority.
  • Evaluate whether resolution actions have fully addressed the customer's need before placing tickets in "Resolved - Awaiting Customer Confirmation" status under the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process, and document resolutions clearly for reuse by other analysts.
  • Assess the age and risk of items in the open ticket queue, decide which require follow-up with users or resolver groups, and take action to prevent tickets from breaching resolution SLAs.
  • Identify gaps and inaccuracies in knowledge articles and Virtual Agent (chatbot) content encountered during resolution and draft recommended new or revised content to improve Tier 0 deflection and First Contact Resolution.
  • Draft plain-language situational awareness alerts that state impact, required user actions, and expected time to resolution for Government pre-approval, and recommend when an emerging pattern of contacts warrants an alert.
  • Contribute observations on incident trends and escalation drivers to Proactive Problem Management, and support execution of customer satisfaction surveys and the collection of CSAT and Customer Effort Score data.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree and 0 years of related experience (an Associate's degree with 2 years of related experience, or 4 years of related experience in lieu of a degree, may be substituted).
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must have an Active Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T3/T3R) to start.
  • Must be willing and able to obtain TS/SCI eligibility after start, if required by mission needs.
  • Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.
  • Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level I baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA A+ CE, Network+ CE, Security+ CE, CCNA-Security, or SSCP) prior to performing cybersecurity-related duties.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.
  • Experience or demonstrated aptitude in help desk, service desk, call center, desktop support, or customer technical support.
  • Working knowledge of Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365 applications, Active Directory account concepts, basic networking (Wi-Fi, VPN, IP connectivity), and common peripherals.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and service desk workflows, including accurate ticket documentation and escalation.
  • Ability to work assigned shifts within a 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET core schedule, and willingness to work extended-hours shifts (evenings, overnight, weekends, and holidays) if assigned to the extended-hours team.
  • Strong customer service orientation, patience, and the ability to communicate clearly with non-technical users by phone and in writing.
  • Ability to follow documented procedures precisely while handling a high volume of contacts in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work a fixed or rotating extended-hours schedule (weeknights 8:01 p.m. to 5:59 a.m. ET and/or weekends 12:00 a.m. to 11:59 p.m. ET), including Federal holidays; this position primarily works remotely.

DESIRED SKILLS:

  • HDI Customer Service Representative, HDI Support Center Analyst, or ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
  • Experience using ServiceNow (incident, request, knowledge, CMDB, Service Catalog, Virtual Agent) or a comparable enterprise ITSM platform.
  • Experience working across multiple security enclaves (NIPRNet, SIPRNet, JWICS) and with classified system handling procedures.
  • Familiarity with customer experience (CX) measurement, including CSAT, Customer Effort Score (CES), and experience level agreements (XLAs).
  • Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or other compliance-driven Federal IT environments.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and mobile device basics.
  • Interest in growing into Tier II desktop support, systems administration, or cybersecurity roles.

About Empower AI

All hiring and promotion decisions at Empower AI are based on merit to bring the best talent available to contribute to our firm’s overall success. It is the policy of Empower AI not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. Empower AI is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

jobs.description:
Overview

This position is responsible for protecting Bio-Rad’s data and cloud estate and for leading high-severity security incident response outside US hours. The role owns the enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, responsible for cloud security (AWS and Azure), and acts as the senior escalation point for security alerts in the non-US time zone. The ideal candidate will have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security or a closely related subject; an advanced degree is preferred. The position requires strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with IT infrastructure, application teams, business users and managed security service providers.

This position is responsible for protecting Bio-Rad’s data and cloud estate and for leading high-severity security incident response outside US hours. The role owns the enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, responsible for cloud security (AWS and Azure), and acts as the senior escalation point for security alerts in the non-US time zone. The ideal candidate will have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security or a closely related subject; an advanced degree is preferred. The position requires strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with IT infrastructure, application teams, business users and managed security service providers.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and manage the enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program end to end – policy design and changes, exception handling, new functionality and rollout – in partnership with Legal and data owners.
  • Define and enforce protection for high-risk company assets by implementing enterprise DLP controls aligned to Legal and regulatory requirements, and maintain a quarterly-reviewed inventory of protected assets with Legal.
  • Reduce Azure/AWS security risk by performing cloud security assessments and remediating all identified findings.
  • Support Azure cloud security engineering work, including Microsoft Graph API automation, secure configuration, and identity and workload hardening.
  • Serve as the security alert lead contact for the non-US time zone for all High and Critical cases, owning end-to-end handling of complex and high-risk incidents through documented closure within SLA.
  • Increase L2 support team’s effectiveness through standardized SOPs, expert guidance, structured escalation support and automation playbooks that shift work left to L2 and reduce escalation volume.
  • Act as integration owner and backup contact for the 3rd party managed detection and response service.
  • Ensure Information Security operations remain compliant with ISO 27001, data privacy regulations and other applicable requirements; support internal audit, FedRAMP and Legal requests.
  • Support Information Security special projects and act as designated backup across key security and GIT domains, building T-shaped skills across the function.
  • Prepare reports, technical presentations and KPI/metrics reporting for management decision-making

Snapshot of the Candidate’s Day: (Describe in a short paragraph, what a day in the life of this role might look like)

  • Reviewing and monitoring security logs for our networks and cloud infrastructure to identify and investigate any potential security threats or vulnerabilities.
  • DLP program – reviewing what the system blocked, tuning policies, and working through exception requests from the business
  • Communicating specific security needs and recommending appropriate security measures.
  • Reviewiong configuration of security tools such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and encryption technologies to protect our networks and data.
  • Keeping up-to-date on the latest security threats and technologies.
  • Assessing and testing networks and cloud infrastructure for vulnerabilities and suggesting remediation steps.
  • Reviewing and Auditing Azure and AWS Security Groups to ensure they are configured in a secure and compliant manner.
  • Responding to security incidents and resolve them. Reporting in multiple report formats.
  • Collaborating with other security experts and stakeholders to improve overall security posture.

How the Candidate Will Make an Impact: (Top 5 bullet points outlining the responsibilities and challenges of the role that allow candidates to make impact)

  • Own Bio-Rad’s DLP program and reach full coverage of data labeled Confidential and Restricted, cutting repeat policy violations by improving policies based on what the system actually blocks.
  • Measurably reduce Azure cloud risk by assessing the estate and closing every Critical and High finding within 90 days of identification.
  • Be the escalation point the business relies on outside US hours, leading High and Critical incidents from detection to documented closure within SLA.
  • Make the L2 team materially stronger through SOPs, coaching and automation playbooks that shift work left and reduce escalations.
  • Keep Information Security operations audit-ready against ISO 27001, data privacy regulations and customer commitments.

What the Candidate Brings: (Top 5 required attributes, skills, and work experience)

  • Deep, hands-on data protection experience – enterprise DLP policy design, tuning and exception management, plus data classification and labeling, ideally with Microsoft Purview.
  • Strong Azure cloud security skills – assessment, secure configuration, identity and workload protection, remediation at scale, and automation via Graph API and scripting.
  • Proven incident response leadership at L2 support team with an MSSP or 24x7 SOC, owning High and Critical cases end to end.
  • Excellent judgment and communication – able to explain risk and trade-offs to Legal, business stakeholders and executives, and to write SOPs that others can follow.

Qualifications:

  • Eight (8) or more years of relevant information security experience, including hands-on ownership of an enterprise security program.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science or a related field; or equivalent work experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience owning an enterprise DLP program – Microsoft Purview DLP and Information Protection preferred – including policy authoring, tuning, exception management and sensitivity labeling of Confidential and Restricted data.
  • Proven experience designing, assessing and remediating Azure cloud security controls (Defender for Cloud, Entra ID, Azure Policy, network and workload security) against compliance and industry best practice; AWS exposure an advantage.
  • Hands-on incident response experience at L2/L3, including ownership of High and Critical cases through closure alongside an MSSP or 24x7 SOC partner, and authorship of SOPs, runbooks and automation/SOAR playbooks. Incident report writing skills.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Graph API and scripting automation (PowerShell, Python) applied to security operations.
  • Knowledge of information security and data privacy laws and frameworks – ISO 27001, GDPR and similar – and experience supporting internal and external audits.
  • Professional certification preferred: CISSP, CCSP, AZ-500, SC-400, GCIH or equivalent.
  • Eight or more years in information security, with working knowledge of ISO 27001 and data privacy requirements, and willingness to cover non-US-hours escalation for global incidents.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to work with Legal, business stakeholders and global IT teams, and available to cover High and Critical escalations in the non-US time zone.

Who We Are: For 70 years, Bio-Rad has focused on advancing the discovery process and transforming the fields of science and healthcare. As one of the top five life science companies, we are a global leader in developing, manufacturing, and marketing a broad range of high-quality research and clinical diagnostic products. We help people everywhere live longer, healthier lives. Recently voted a Best Place to Work, Bio-Rad offers a unique employee experience with collaborative teams that span the globe. Here, you are supported by leadership to build your career and are empowered to drive change that makes an impact you can see.

Benefits: Bio-Rad's biggest asset is its people, and the reason why our Total Rewards deliver programs that provide value, quality, and inclusivity while satisfying the diverse needs of our evolving workforce. Our robust offerings serve to enrich the overall health, wealth, and wellbeing of our employees through the various stages of an employee’s work and life cycle. We’re proud to offer a variety of options, including competitive insurance plans for you and your immediate family, Annual Health checkup , Marriage Leave, Paternity Leave ,Employee Assistance Programme , extensive learning and development opportunities, and more.

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing
jobs.excerpt: OverviewRachio is looking for a Director of Product Marketing to own how Rachio decides what to build, how we position it, and how we bring it to market across hardware, software, and subscriptions.
jobs.description:
Overview

Rachio is looking for a Director of Product Marketing to own how Rachio decides what to build, how we position it, and how we bring it to market across hardware, software, and subscriptions. This is a senior leader role at Rachio and the owner of our go-to-market (GTM) processes: the mechanism that takes an idea from concept through business case, launch, and post-launch iteration, and helps to surface key debates and to align cross functional teams (across Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, Sales, Support, and Marketing) to a shared set of goals.

The scope spans smart lighting, smart sprinkler and hose controllers, partner and OEM products, and the software and subscription experiences that sit on top of them. It's inherently cross-functional and inherently commercial: you are measured on adoption, revenue, and channel performance, not on the volume of collateral produced. The right person is equally comfortable running a customer research plan, writing a pricing and positioning narrative for the exec team, and sitting in a firmware trade-off conversation with engineering to understand what a feature actually does before deciding how to sell it.

A note on how this role works. Rachio runs a flat organization that maintains a high ownership and fast paced start-up culture. As such, this is a senior individual contributor role. Your influence comes from the quality of your thinking, the clarity of your writing, and your credibility with the people who own the functions you depend on - not from headcount. It has large ownership and depends on your ability to form clear, concise data-driven strategies that earn trust on the team and drive decisions. If you're looking for a role where you set direction and a team executes it, this isn't that role. If you want the leverage of shaping a category-leading portfolio without the overhead of a large org, it is.

Responsibilities

Own the GTM process

  • Build and run the end-to-end GTM process that moves opportunities from ideation to in-market execution, including setting the strategy, collecting feedback, sizing of opportunities, determining key debates and decisions with clear business cases, stage gates, launch readiness, and post-launch review.
  • Set the strategic goals and success criteria for each initiative up front, and drive alignment on them across Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Sales, Support, Marketing, and others.
  • Own launch readiness as a mechanism, not a meeting: clear owners, clear dates, clear go/no-go criteria, and an honest retro afterward.
  • Identify where the process itself is the bottleneck and fix it. This role is expected to build repeatable GTM motions and systems that can scale your work across teams.

Be the senior product marketing voice in roadmap and product development

  • Partner with Product Management to shape the roadmap that’s led with data: market sizing, customer research, competitive intelligence, channel input, and knowledgeable ways to leverage AI to organize the data into tangible next steps.
  • Maintain a working understanding of the market: competitive lineups, adjacent smart home platforms and protocols, pro channel dynamics, and where the category is heading.

Positioning, messaging, and pricing

  • Define positioning and messaging architecture for hardware, software, and subscription offerings, and translate technical capability into language customers and pros actually use.
  • Own the single source of truth for each product: positioning, claims, feature availability, competitive comparisons, FAQs, and objection handling.
  • Develop pricing and packaging recommendations in partnership with Product, Sales, and Marketing: good/better/best structures, subscription tiers, channel-specific SKUs, promotional strategy. Each should include financial modeling to support the recommendations.

Launch and channel execution

  • Lead integrated launches across the professional channel, retail, and D2C.
  • Build the enablement that makes the channel effective: support of pro training, distributor and rep materials, retail line reviews, packaging and shelf messaging, product spec and comparison tools.
  • Partner with the Brand Studio and Marketing team to translate positioning into campaigns and measure what they return.
  • Action and close the post-launch feedback loops: what's confusing customers, what's driving returns, what priorities we need to improve CSAT.
  • Lead international expansion opportunities with agency and contractor support where it makes sense.
  • How to size new country expansion and how to build brand awareness in these regions with targeted customer segments.

Voice of the customer and measurement

  • Own the customer research agenda across homeowners and professional installers: qualitative and quantitative, primary and syndicated.
  • Instrument launches so success is measurable: adoption, attach and activation rates, sell-through, ASP, retention, NPS.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of product marketing, GTM, or closely related commercial experience, including significant time owning initiatives end-to-end.
  • Comfort operating as a hands-on individual contributor. You write the narrative and docs, build the model, and run the launch yourself rather than assigning it.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a full product lifecycle from concept through launch and iteration, with results you can speak to specifically.
  • Experience marketing connected hardware, consumer electronics, IoT, or technical products, including the realities of long hardware lead times, supply constraints, certification, and channel timing.
  • Experience marketing software or subscription offerings: adoption, attach, retention, and monetization.
  • Track record of driving direction and alignment across product, engineering, finance, operations, and sales without owning those functions.
  • Strong analytical foundation: comfortable building the model, working in spreadsheets and BI tools, and defending the assumptions.
  • Exceptional written communication. Distill a complex set of decisions into a written narrative a leadership team can act on.
  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience building GTM or NPI processes from scratch, or materially rebuilding one that wasn't working.
  • Experience in two-step distribution or professional trade channels (irrigation, landscape, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, building products) alongside retail and D2C.
  • Experience with smart home platforms and protocols: Matter, Thread, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and have enough technical fluency to be useful in engineering conversations.
  • Experience with outdoor products, lighting, water management, or the sustainability categories.
  • Experience with partner, OEM, or co-marketing programs.
  • MBA or advanced degree.

Salary range for candidates based in California: $248,000 - $372,000

Salary range for candidates based in Colorado - New York- New York City or Maryland : $232,000 - $348,000

Salary ranges include base salary and annual incentive bonus if applicable.

Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

Rachio is an equal opportunity employer.

APIs and microservices

jobs.description:
Overview

Consilio builds eDiscovery and legal technology solutions used by legal teams at major organizations. Our users make consequential decisions inside our products — often under deadline, always under scrutiny. The work is high-stakes by nature: decisions made inside our products carry legal weight.

We're looking for a Lead UX Designer to own design for critical areas of our product suite and to serve as a steward of our design system. Two things make this role unusual. First, you'll be working out how AI shows up inside these workflows. Second, you'll be setting the standards that hold the experience together across a multi-product portfolio, and governing how those standards get used.

This is an individual contributor role. You will set direction, and you'll have real influence over what gets built.

How this role operates

You'll partner with Product and Engineering early — shaping the problem, not styling a decision that's already been made. You'll prototype fast to explore and align, and work with Engineering to keep design and code in sync.

Our internal design team is small and growing. You'll have more ownership than you'd get at a mature design org, and less existing infrastructure to lean on.

Responsibilities

· Own end-to-end design for one or more product areas, from problem framing through delivery and post-launch iteration

· Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early, not just execute on requirements

· Translate in-flight product strategy into journeys, information architecture, and interaction patterns

· Define the interaction models for AI-assisted workflows: how users understand what the system did, why it did it, and how far to trust it

· Evolve and maintain Consilio's design system — defining components and patterns, and setting the standards for how they're used

· Build accessibility standards into the system rather than retrofitting it

· Prototype rapidly to explore, align, and de-risk decisions using modern AI tools

· Lead or partner on user research, and turn findings into decisions other people can act on

· Make the case for design decisions and system standards to senior stakeholders through evidence and clear storytelling

Qualifications

· 8+ years designing complex enterprise or B2B software, with shipped work you can walk us through

· Hands-on experience building and maintaining a design system in a multi-product environment — not just consuming one

· Experience designing end-to-end journeys for multi product ecosystems

· Experience with Figma Make, or other similar prompt-based prototyping tools.

· Depth in interaction design, with visual craft strong enough to make the work persuasive

· Demonstrated experience partnering with Product and Engineering from problem definition forward

· Bachelor’s degree in Design (e.g., Interaction, Visual, Industrial Design), HCI, or equivalent practical experience.

Qualities we're looking for

· Systems thinking. You design for scale and consistency by default, not as a cleanup pass.

· Standards judgment. You know when to generalize a pattern and when a one-off is the right answer — and you can say no to a component request without damaging the relationship.

· Comfort with ambiguity. You can make a defensible tradeoff without perfect information, and revisit it when better information arrives.

· Influence without authority. You change what gets built by being persuasive and well-reasoned, not by escalating.

· Clarity under complexity. You can take a genuinely complicated workflow and make it feel obvious.

Portfolio

· Strong portfolio demonstrating complex workflow design across multiple web-based enterprise products.

· Work samples that showcase prototyping ability.

Nice to have

· Experience with AI driven products or designing AI powered interactions

· Formal or self-directed learning in AI/ML concepts

· Prior experience designing for legal, compliance, healthcare, financial services, or another high-consequence regulated domain.

Consilio’s True North Values

  • Client Experience | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  • Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
  • Innovation | Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
  • Grit | Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

Responsibilities

Peraton is hiring a Data Architecture, Lead Associate. This work is 100% remote.

This role builds and extends a greenfield data and AI platform supporting federal background investigation work. Working alongside the platform's lead engineer, you'll develop and maintain the pipelines, transformations, and data products that move the platform forward — growing your ownership as the platform matures. This is hands-on engineering in a high-trust environment where FedRAMP Moderate, NIST 800-171, and CUI handling shape how the work is built.

Active clearance preferred; candidates able to obtain one encouraged to apply.

  • Build, test, and maintain data ingestion, transformation, and pipeline code that turns raw and synthetic data into governed, analysis-ready data products.
  • Extend the platform following the architecture, patterns, and standards set by the lead platform engineer.
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines that promote work into the accredited production environment.
  • Monitor data quality, pipeline reliability, and performance; troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Apply data governance, cataloging, and access-control practices within the established framework.
  • Support the data science and ML team by delivering the governed datasets and tooling they need.
  • Operate within FedRAMP Moderate, NIST 800-171, and CUI constraints in day-to-day engineering.
  • Collaborate closely with the engineering team and maintain clear documentation of pipelines and processes.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a T5/SSBI federally adjudicated clearance; active clearance preferred.
  • 4 years building and maintaining production data pipelines.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Hands-on ETL / data pipeline development and sound analytical data modeling.
  • Working familiarity with cloud data platforms (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP fine) and version control / CI/CD workflows.
  • Solid analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • 5 years work experience with BS/BA

Preferred Qualifications

  • Databricks experience (or a comparable lakehouse stack: Spark, Delta, dbt, Snowflake).
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and CI/CD for data workloads.
  • Experience in regulated or accredited environments: FedRAMP, NIST 800-171, CMMC, or CUI handling.
  • Active security clearance (T5/SSBI or higher).
  • Government or defense contracting experience.
  • Familiarity with data governance / cataloging tooling (e.g., Unity
  • Catalog) and orchestration tools (Airflow, dbt).

Soft Skills

  • Dependable, self-directed execution with minimal oversight.
  • Strong collaboration across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Clear documentation and knowledge-sharing.
  • Eagerness to grow ownership and learn the compliance environment.

Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace.
